name: Sagami
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 65); Porter’s note gives the dates as: fl. 1051.

poems.title: Be not displeased, but pardon me
poems.author: Sagami
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 65
poems.text:
Be not displeased, but pardon me,
If still my tears o’erflow;
My lover ’s gone, and my good name,
Which once I valued so,
I fear must also go.

poems.title: 65. 恨み侘び ほさぬ袖だに あるものを (Urami wabi hosanu sode dani aru mono o)
poems.author: Sagami
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 後拾遺集
poems.text:
恨み侘び ほさぬ袖だに あるものを
戀に朽ちなむ 名こそ惜しけれ
